quests.instruction: It is half past seven in the morning — time to grab your backpack. What time is it?
quests.question: 7:30 AM
quests.hint: Half past seven means the minute hand has traveled all the way down to the 6.
quests.explanation: Half past seven means 30 minutes after seven, so it is written 7:30 AM.
quests.funFact: When the minute hand points to the 6, exactly half an hour has gone by.
